name: bleam-chat
description: Built-in chat participant that connects to an OpenAI-compatible endpoint.

chatParticipants.name: bleam
chatParticipants.description: Bleam's built-in assistant for code, docs, and troubleshooting.
chatParticipants.sampleRequest: Summarize the key files in this workspace.

bleamChat.apiKey.description: OpenAI-compatible API key used for chat requests. Can also be provided via the BLEAM_CHAT_API_KEY environment variable.

bleamChat.baseUrl.description: Base URL for the OpenAI-compatible API (for example, https://api.openai.com/v1 or http://localhost:11434/v1).

bleamChat.model.description: Model name to request from the OpenAI-compatible API.

bleamChat.maxTokens.description: Maximum tokens to generate for a response.

bleamChat.systemPrompt.default: You are Bleam, a helpful coding assistant.
bleamChat.systemPrompt.description: System prompt prepended to each request.

bleamChat.includeHistory.description: Include chat history when sending requests to the model.
